expectations: Both actual TCP HTTP hops, main API and local neural provider, run in the same managed invocation.
The loaded base bytes, tokenizer contract and CPU runtime match the pinned identity; adapter mode additionally requires a hash-verified completed training receipt.
Four completed responses use the openai-compatible neural path and preserve one session; no evidence-preview response counts as neural success.
Retrieved evidence and any emitted citation bindings match unchanged training records; marker coverage is reported separately from functional transport checks.
The fifth stream closes after one nonempty model token while provider health still reports busy; no completed partial turn enters session memory.
Provider becomes idle after cancellation, a same-session recovery turn completes, and session deletion succeeds.
Every stage saves raw traces and a report incrementally; every child process and server is stopped on success or failure.
No voice model, human rating, semantic entailment, persona fidelity or production promotion is part of this probe.
persistence_boundary: Save the complete private output and verify fresh readback before claiming the functional run is preserved.
related_experiments: Separate from frozen M6 matched54 and six heldout retrieval diagnostic calls; these functional outputs are never merged into their scores.

adapter_training.basis: Frozen Jensen text experiment: 113 complete exchanges across nine events, with 29 planned optimizer updates; candidate must be completed and locally artifact-verified before serving.
